items.name: gold-coilsleep-1
items.prompt: Make this same coiled golden horned snake fast asleep: its eyes gently closed in two soft curved lines like the sleeping snake head in the second picture, a calm content smile, its head resting low on top of its coils. Keep everything else exactly the same as the first picture: the same pose and coils, the same size and position in the frame, the same golden-yellow scales, two small dark horns, red-brown cheek patch, the same painted storybook style with dark ink outlines. Plain flat grey background.
